articleTitle: The e-Learning System Model Based on Affective Computing
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: E-Learning is a kind of study system. Inthis system we can teach and learn through the Internetand other digitized media. Affective Computing isrelated to, arises from or deliberately influencesemotions. It tries to construct a kind of computer systemwhich can recognize, synthesize and understand thehuman emotions to make intelligent, smart, friendlyreaction. In this paper we combine the e-Learningsystem with Affective computing to propose the e-Learning system model based on Affective computing.This system can resolve the problem of communicationdeficiency between the computer and users effectively.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis for Educational Software Quality Hierarchy Triangle
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: The area of educational software evaluation has been increasingly muddled because of a lack of consensus among software evaluators. This article presents the classification and evaluation granularity of educational software, proposes an educational software quality hierarchy triangle model based on some major software quality models, analyzes the signification and relativity of the factors. At last, it indicates the primary analysis for the model formalization.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Learning Based on 3G Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: 3G is a kind of new generation mobile communication system which combines wireless communication with Internet. This paper expatiates concept of mobile learning, realization technology of mobile learning, and mobile learning model based on 3G technology.

articleTitle: Learning with a QQ-Based Collaborative e-Learning System
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: E-learning is becoming increasingly popular in higher education, from which both students and instructors gain benefits. In this paper, we present our QQ-based collaborative e-learning system for programming courses. QQ is a popular communication software in China, which may facilitate collaborative learning in the following ways: interaction, individual accountability, team work, and personalized guidance. Our experience indicates that it offers better performance than mere classroom learning. The experience is evaluated from both instructors' and students' points of view.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation on Technologies of Constructing Network Virtual Lab
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: With the continue development and progress of computer and network technologies, network virtual laboratory gains more and more deployment. First of all, this paper introduces the roadmap and characters of network virtual lab. Second, we give out several key technologies that can implement network virtual lab, such as Java ,ActiveX , VRML and ASP. At the end, we discuss the implementation procedure of network virtual laboratory based on J2EE technology in deep.

articleTitle: Mechanism of Pricing Dynamically for Web Services
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: To promote application of web services in streamlining business-to-business or enterprise application integration, many researches on web services architecture, composition, and security have been done. However, pricing mechanism is necessary for commercialism of web services. Taking quality of service (QoS) and user experience into account, a QoS-driven dynamic web services pricing mechanism is put up in the paper, which makes services price vary dynamically with corresponding factors. Based on the mechanism, a simple prototype is developed. And then its architecture and pricing process is described. Experiments show that the web services pricing model works well and makes service price more reasonable and precise.

articleTitle: Research of Ubiquitous Learning Application Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: The method of human learning has changed a lot with the rapid development of information technology, as one can see that appropriate technical support can improve human learning. As a new learning mode, ubiquitous learning has broken through the traditional limitations of e-Learning, and gain much more attention from scholars at home and abroad in recent years. By considering the similarity between JXTA network platform and ubiquitous learning, this paper use JXTA network platform to construct the new ubiquitous learning application environment, and proves the feasibility of ubiquitous learning through an application service composition sample.

articleTitle: Design and Implement of a Web Examination System Using Struts and EJB
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: The Web examination systems at present have many limitations including limited number of simultaneous, online users can not fully satisfy the needs of large-scale unified examinations. In addition, as the control code mixed with the page code, the software is inconvenient to upgrade and transplant. We propose using MVC model, Struts and J2EE's EJB technology to develop Web examination system in order to improve the access speed and increase the number of the simultaneous online users. Moreover, the structure of the procedure is more clarity; the performance of the system is more stability and the source code is higher reused.

articleTitle: Online Class based on Environment Ontology
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: Currently, more and more Web services provide online class service for learners. However, these services are not machine- understandable so that itpsilas difficult to achieve automatic discovery, interaction and composition. The semantic Web is the emerging landscape of new web technologies aiming at Web-based information and services that would be understandable and reusable by both humans and machines. This Web revolution will be helpful for Web-based learning. This paper presents a preliminary framework for the online class based on environment ontology which is used to achieve more precise discovery.

articleTitle: A Harmonious Emotion Interaction Model for Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: In order to raise study efficiency in distance education, how to realize humanistic solicitude and harmonious emotion interaction between man and machine has become the important subject that should be researched thoroughly. This paper describes the theory and methods of emotional information processing as well as Affective Computing Contents and other related technology. Besides, it presents the FPBDIC Agent Mental Model and the Intelligent Personality Education System Model with techniques in the course of researching on harmonious man-machine emotion interaction system based on software Agent technology.

articleTitle: The Research of Mobile Support Synergistic Learning
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: M-Learning is called the future of distance education, synergistic learning is a new framework of learning technology system too. Based on M-Learning and synergistic learning,a new research field,mobile support synergistic learning(MSSL) , was created. MSSL makes both of them supported each other. In this paper, mobile support synergistic learning, a new mode of distance education, including the two origins theories, was introduced. Following that, the definition and the fundamental frame of MSSL were discussed. Finally, the features of MSSL were explained.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Approach to eMM
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: eMM (e-learning maturity model) is used for evaluating the capability and maturity of an institution engaged in e-learning. Based on the original eMM, we suggest a quantitative approach , which can set up an eMM process meta-model as a frame of reference to process improvement, use process capability baseline to metric process capability, make quality estimation and project management, while use SPC to control itspsila continuous process improvement.

articleTitle: RAE: A Framework and Modeling Method for Distributed Learning System
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: Basing on the constructivism learning environment design theory and the generalization of abundant experience of designing and developing distributed learning system, this paper brings forth a set of approaches to RAE(Role-Activity-Environment) learning system modeling that has combined object-oriented methods and instructional system design methods. The basic principle, modeling processes and model framework of RAE have been elucidated in detail.

articleTitle: Research and Development of an Auto-Producing System for Course Website
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: During the construction of top-quality course to improve the quality of high education, it is an absolutely key point of using computer technique to develop a course Website. For the importance and complexity of developing on the top-quality course website, the paper focuses on the Website auto-producing system. In the paper, we propose the design ideal of template and navigation, and the data flow of system. Moreover, we discuss the key point in construction of top-quality course Website, the main function of the system and the implementation technology in detail. Finally, it is applied in the construction of the course of ldquotutorial of educational technologyrdquo in our university. The experimental results show the real value of making shorter time and Simplifying the procedure of developing.

articleTitle: A Study of Construction and Share Digital Resources in an Higher Education District in China
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: This article includes the digital library experience in Xiasha education district of Hangzhou city in China. The first part is the necessity to construct the digital library center in the changing trends of the higher education in China. It appears that the traditional library could not follow the trends of the higher education in China. The second part is the technology experience for building up the digital library. It introduces the theory structure and construction steps of digital library and resource. In this section, we introduce all levels of the structure theory. Meanwhile, we show the steps of constructing the digital library including organization of the committee, connection of Internet and the hardware of computers, standard and development of software and preservation and building up of digital resource.

articleTitle: Organization of Documents for Multiple Document Summarization
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: Multiple document summarization technique can be utilized for improving the effectiveness of retrieval and accessibility of learning objects in e-learning. Related study has shown that hierarchical summarization is a promising technique which can effectively extract the most important information from the source documents. Hierarchical summarization has been extended to summarization of multiple documents. Three hierarchical structures were proposed to organize a set of related documents. This paper investigates the impact of document structure on hierarchical summarization.

articleTitle: The Design of Web-learning Navigator Based on Artificial Psychology
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: Emphasizing particularly on emotional interactions, this paper proposes a Web-based, personalized e-learning navigation design, which is composed of emotion modeling based on artificial psychology, image recognition, Web log analysis and knowledge level evaluation based on cognitive psychology. In this paper, eye-sight track and student-computer interaction are presented. Eye-sight track aims at tracking on-line which contents on computerpsilas screen are concentrated on by the learner. Through the interactions between test-pages and learners, their real-time learning interests as well as encountered difficulties in learning process can be identified. By adopting artificial psychology theories and knowledge level-structure evaluation method, each individual studentpsilas knowledge level and knowledge background are evaluated. Then bases on the information fusion with respect to the above attained information, an optimal learning plan or curriculum structure can be provided via the ultimate evaluation result, some constructive suggestions are provided as well. The design will greatly improve the learning efficiency of student and promote human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Construction of Collaborative Learning System Based on Multi-Agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: Web-based collaborative learning or named computer supported collaboration learning (CSCL) is a new mode of learning supported with computer technology, which is humanized and intelligent and makes the whole system more complicated. Agent is a new computing method to solve intelligent application of complication, dynamic, and distribution. Agent, with intelligence, operates spontaneously, and simulates manpsilas social behavior and relations to some extent. Moreover, it provides relevant services to other software. This paper presents the construction of collaborative learning system based on multi-agent technology after studying the characteristics of agent technology and collaborative learning system.

articleTitle: Application of E-Portfolio in the Distance Chinese Language Visualization Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: The paper first explains the connotation of E-portfolio and the reason why introduce the E-portfolio to the Distance Chinese Language Visualization Teaching Platform as the diagnostic service evaluation tool, and then designs the function modules of E-portfolio according to the function requirements analysis, finally explains the application of E-portfolio in Chinese learning and the evaluation process based on it.

articleTitle: To Analyze Assessment Using SPC Table
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: How to provide the information about problem and course to learner? It was the major function that SPC table would solve. Using SPC table made the exam data became the quantification profile. It could provide us much information that came from each student, problem and course. First, viewed students had progressed status in each chapter of posttest. Second, it displayed the further data about the problems. Third, the educator could comprehend the education situation. We used much data to try out the effect about SPC table. In the experiment we added some variable was we give the feedback information to class B. The significant propose was made difference between two classes and viewed the SPC table easily. The result exhibited obvious the information from each exam.

articleTitle: About e-Learning Application in Communication Teaching
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: This article introduces the concept of e-Learning and gives its corresponding architecture. Based on this three-layer architecture of the e-learning, this article proposes the systematic design and the implementation scheme for teaching the communicational courses while meeting the training requirements of the students of the communication engineering major in the e-learning environment.

articleTitle: Research on Learning Resource Design under the Environment of Network
publicationTitle: 2008 Seventh International Conference on Web-based Learning
abstract: How to design the network learning resources? This is a important problem that we need to solve carrying out network teaching. Based on the demonstration and investigation about External Chinese Visualization Teaching Platform, this article analyses the current problem of network learning resource design in our country, and brings forward the content system: the leaning resource design of content, navigation, display, interaction, support, evaluation, hoping to provide a reference for the building of current network learning resource design.
